description: Graph coloring problems where greedy coloring in the given node order gets stuck. The graph is K-colorable, but the model must backtrack and recolor earlier nodes to complete the coloring.

prefill_messages.content:

Edges: A-C, A-D, A-E, A-G, B-D, B-F, B-G, C-D, C-F, D-F, G-H

  B: D, F, G
  C: A, D, F
  D: A, B, C, F
  E: A
  F: B, C, D
  G: A, B, H
  H: G

Color the nodes in this order: F, C, E, B, H, D, A, G.
For each node, assign the smallest valid color (not used by any already-colored neighbor).

You have one response. State your answer as SUBMIT: [Node] -> [color] for every node.
